name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Projected Distinguishing Range
details: The candidate universal inequality $\mathrm{Edim}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm R^p(\mathcal H)$ is false, already for a finite binary class.
proof: For $\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ER}}$, the checked values are $\mathrm{Edim}=4$ and $\mathrm R^p=5$.
